hidden_assumptions: artifact swaps stay in-distribution for the agent
the drawn box is the evidence used rather than a decorative output channel
answer-change rate interpretable without difficulty-matched controls

one_liner: Register/high-norm artifact map as free per-pixel error predictor
harshest_attack: Norm-as-confidence is an old primitive; PH-Reg shows artifacts are not reliably high-norm; artifacts sit in easy background so the norm map may be a saliency prior beaten by distance-to-boundary and softmax entropy; test-time registers remove the artifact for free and register-equipped backbones shrink the applicable model population.
hidden_assumptions: norm monotone in error within foreground strata
artifact positions input-dependent enough to track image-specific errors (SINDER says defect direction is weight-determined)
signal survives on register-equipped backbones
sparse artifact coverage can move aggregate AUROC
killer_experiment: Stratified AUROC audit (~1 GPU-week): norm map vs entropy, distance-to-boundary, edge density, prototype distance on ADE20K+Cityscapes, within foreground/background and boundary-distance strata, on register-free, register-equipped, and test-time-register-patched backbones; must beat baselines within foreground on register-free models.
mutated_claim: Is the artifact map an uncertainty channel or a saliency prior? A stratified uncertainty-baselines audit (not a free-lunch pitch).

one_liner: Language alignment causally degrades metric depth at matched data
harshest_attack: arXiv 2510.11835 (EMNLP 2025) already pretrained CLIP vs DINO at matched architecture/data/config — the 'nobody has done the controlled contrast' premise is dead; CVPR 2024 language-guidance-depth work plus Probing-3D-Awareness make the direction consensus, so the binary causal claim is low information.
hidden_assumptions: captioned-subset pretraining data is depth-cue-neutral
CLIP-style contrastive alignment stands in for language generally
linear depth decodability operationalizes geometric structure
small-scale effect predicts flagship scale
killer_experiment: Stage 1 (cheap): run El Banani 3D probes + metric-depth probes on the 2510.11835 matched checkpoints (or replicas). Stage 2 (the paper): alignment-strength dose-response (lambda dial) on one matched corpus with depth-cue decomposition (occlusion/perspective/texture-gradient).
mutated_claim: Dose-response and cue-decomposition of the language-alignment geometry tax at matched data — extending 2510.11835 from VQA-level to dense geometry.

one_liner: VPT prompt tokens are trainable registers
harshest_attack: DA-VPT already connects VPT prompt artifacts to registers in print; registers-as-attention-biases is published (test-time registers), giving a competing mechanism; frozen-random-token control confounds register absorption with softmax-temperature effects; the likely partial-reproduction outcome is mush; register-equipped backbones make it a paper about the past.
hidden_assumptions: frozen-random tokens isolate register function rather than generic attention-capacity effects
VPT benchmark gains are robust targets
high-norm signature equals register function (PH-Reg contradicts)
transfer across VPT-shallow vs deep
killer_experiment: 4-arm x 2-backbone design: full VPT vs frozen-random tokens vs attention-bias-only injection vs no-token, on register-free AND register-equipped siblings, >=3 dense + 3 classification tasks, with pre-registered prediction that register-equipped backbones gain less from VPT.
mutated_claim: Decomposition of VPT gains into learned vs absorptive vs attention-bias components, quantified across register regimes (DA-VPT cited up front).

one_liner: Language quantizes shape space via morph-trajectory discontinuities
harshest_attack: Categorical warping along morph continua in category-trained deep nets is a 2021 result (Bonnasse-Gahot & Nadal), so any categorical supervision quantizes — the causal attribution to language collapses without a supervised-ImageNet control the proposal lacks; a 2026 morph-continuum framework (2603.24730) already compares human and machine boundaries.
hidden_assumptions: SSL models are a clean smooth-trajectory null
morph midpoints equally on-manifold across model families
human naming boundaries stable across render styles
curvature statistics separate quantization from generic non-smoothness
killer_experiment: Full grid: {CLIP-lineage, SSL, supervised ImageNet ViT} x {3D-render, latent, image-space morphs}; pre-registered prediction that jump locations align with human naming boundaries only for language-aligned models, taxonomy boundaries for supervised, neither for SSL; plus boundary depth/pose-decodability readout.
mutated_claim: Categorical warping follows the supervision taxonomy: naming boundaries predict discontinuity locations in language-aligned models, class boundaries in supervised models, neither in SSL.

one_liner: Modality-gap collapse as phase transition predicting zero-shot loss
harshest_attack: MG-CLIP (2507.09118) and GNSP (2507.19839) already track modality-gap dynamics during fine-tuning, treat gap variation as the degradation indicator, and build methods on preserving it — gap-dynamics-as-forgetting-signal is now the premise of two methods papers, not a discovery.
hidden_assumptions: scalar gap statistic captures relevant geometry (few dimensions drive the gap per 2404.07983)
collapse leads rather than co-occurs with zero-shot loss
single-task FT behaves like the CL settings where the indicator is established
killer_experiment: 4 tasks x 4 LRs x 3 seeds: changepoint-sharpness test vs smooth-drift null; lead-time measurement of gap-collapse onset over zero-shot-degradation onset; predictive AUC vs loss/gradient/weight-norm baselines.
mutated_claim: Gap collapse as a leading indicator with actionable lead time, benchmarked against cheap baselines in single-task fine-tuning — the quantitative validation MG-CLIP/GNSP assumed.

one_liner: Mention bias: unmentioned-but-visible content is decodability-poor
harshest_attack: arXiv 2406.09067 already measured the caption gap (unmentioned-object decodability plummets in caption-trained encoders) and 2404.07983 already ran the causal caption-presence intervention in controlled retraining — both halves of the paper exist; the residual is a dose-response curve on top of their union.
hidden_assumptions: corpus mention probability estimable without detector circularity
SSL decodability is a clean visual-difficulty control
dense version differs materially from published object-level version
killer_experiment: Per-pixel decodability across ~200 categories spanning the mention-probability range, SSL-normalized, fit dose-response; one small-scale caption-intervention retraining raising/lowering mention probability of held-out categories to test curve shift.
mutated_claim: The mention-probability dose-response law for dense decodability and its causal shift under caption intervention.

one_liner: PEFT invariance-inheritance ceiling on dense tasks
harshest_attack: Risks being 'LoRA learns less' restated in invariance vocabulary — analytically true and empirically empty; causal arrow unargued (retained invariance may be a passive correlate of small displacement); intruder dimensions show LoRA is structurally different, undermining the cannot-break-invariance premise; 'no rank increase helps' is falsified by the first high-rank ablation if wrong.
hidden_assumptions: invariance measurable without head contamination
modern SSL backbones actually carry strong invariances to inherit
difficulty-matched dissociation tasks are constructible
invariance-breaking demand quantifiable non-circularly
killer_experiment: Invariance-dissociation grid: task pairs matched on frozen-probe difficulty differing in invariance-breaking demand; LoRA across ranks incl. high rank vs full FT; paper lives iff PEFT gap tracks demand at matched difficulty AND persists at high rank.
mutated_claim: If high rank closes the gap: merge into 0101 as rank-dependence of invariance-breaking.

one_liner: Generated-image contamination of web benchmarks distorts rankings
harshest_attack: Detector error rates are unknown on benchmark distributions (Hataya's own warning); at low base rates flags are mostly false positives; detector-flagged subsets are non-random image-property strata so ranking shifts may be stratification artifacts — the estimator is the paper and the estimator is uncalibrated.
hidden_assumptions: detector ensembles + manual subsample bound error at ~2% base rates
collection dates recoverable for web benchmarks
ranking deltas exceed subset-resampling noise
killer_experiment: Three calibration arms before the headline audit: placebo (run pipeline on guaranteed-clean pre-2021 benchmarks), injection (seed known generated images at controlled rates, verify recovery), provenance (manual + watermark verification subsample with CIs).

one_liner: Resolution x probe confound audit overturning VFM dense rankings (merged w/ 0200)
harshest_attack: Kerssies et al. already documented setting-sensitivity of VFM rankings; 'matched resolution' has no unique definition, so corrected rankings are just different rankings under the auditor's free parameter — models co-designed with native resolution are penalized by any matching, and benchmark authors will call resolution handling a capability, not a confound.
hidden_assumptions: a defensible partition of resolution-handling from representation quality exists
published conclusions are pinned enough to invert
probe and resolution effects separable from three-way task interactions
killer_experiment: Audit under >=3 pre-registered matching definitions (pixel-, feature-map-, FLOP-matched) x probe capacities; deliverable is the set of published conclusions that invert under ALL matchings; if empty, publish rankings-are-resolution-robust.
mutated_claim: Robust-inversion audit: which published VFM-comparison conclusions invert under every defensible matching convention.

one_liner: Shift budgets: frozen degrades gracefully, tuned sharply (mutated form)
harshest_attack: Direction is textbook (LP-FT/WiSE-FT/Andreassen); shift magnitude is not a scalar so budget curves are parameterized by an arbitrary ladder; crossover points will not transfer across shift families (the expected outcome), and WiSE-FT interpolation dominates the deployment decision the curve is meant to inform.
hidden_assumptions: an approximately model-independent shift ordering exists
frozen-vs-tuned remains the relevant dichotomy in the WiSE-FT era
curve shapes estimable at high severities with small noisy eval sets
killer_experiment: Fit budget curves on corruption ladders for 6 models; test cross-family transfer of crossovers to geographic/temporal shifts; add WiSE-FT interpolation arms; pre-register functional forms; publish transfer or its failure.
mutated_claim: Functional-form stability of degradation curves across shift families, with interpolation arms — already E's mutation; this round adds the WiSE-FT arm as mandatory.

one_liner: Task-indexed required-rank law for PEFT (mutated form)
harshest_attack: The regressor (spectral mass of full-FT deltas) is seed/LR-dependent noise unless cross-seed stability is shown first — nobody has; intruder-dimension results say LoRA does not approximate truncated full FT, so accuracy need not track captured mass at all; adaptive-rank PEFT already solves the practical problem without a law that requires a full FT run to compute.
hidden_assumptions: delta spectra stable across seeds/LR
a cheap spectral proxy exists that avoids full FT
layerwise heterogeneity aggregates to a task index
monotone accuracy-vs-captured-mass despite structural solution differences
killer_experiment: (a) Cross-seed spectral stability (3 seeds x 3 tasks, nearly free — stop if unstable); (b) rank sweeps regressed on captured mass vs cheap baselines (gradient-covariance spectrum at init); (c) held-out-task prediction.
mutated_claim: Only if (a) passes: spectral-mass law vs cheap predictors, cross-task validated.

one_liner: Spatial calibration decays before accuracy in dense adaptation (mutated form)
harshest_attack: Ordering already published for CL/LLMs; if per-region temperature re-tuning restores calibration the claim collapses to 'confidence scale drifts first,' which has no deployment consequence; ECE-vs-accuracy onset comparisons are metrically rigged and region-level ECE estimators are biased with few pixels per bin.
hidden_assumptions: calibration decay not reducible to temperature drift
region-level ECE estimable at claimed onset doses
ordering has usable lead time
killer_experiment: Dose trajectories on 3 dense tasks: regional accuracy, ECE, Brier, AND temperature-corrected ECE with one pre-registered onset procedure for all metrics; paper exists iff ordering survives temperature correction and predicts later accuracy loss with lead time.
mutated_claim: Temperature-robust spatial calibration decay as a regional early-warning signal (already E's mutation; temperature arm now mandatory).

fresh_hits.title: Continual Calibration: Coverage Can Collapse Before Accuracy

one_liner: Segmentation sycophancy: confidence rises with prompt count, accuracy doesn't
harshest_attack: Prompt count is not randomized in practice — users escalate on hard cases, so the confidence-accuracy divergence is plausibly pure selection bias; SAM confidence-error misalignment is already documented (RUAC's mask-confidence confusion, UncertainSAM), leaving only the dose-response shape.
hidden_assumptions: a standardized cross-architecture confidence exists
simulated clickers represent human escalation (RClicks says no)
accuracy stagnation holds conditional on difficulty
killer_experiment: Randomized-dose protocol: difficulty-stratified images, prompt count assigned randomly 1-10, multiple click policies + RClicks human-click distribution; sycophancy exists iff the confidence-accuracy gap grows with randomized dose within strata (~1 week compute).

fresh_hits.title: RUAC: Robust Uncertainty-Accuracy Correlation for SAM

one_liner: Negative clicks hurt beyond 2-3: anti-monotone dose-response
harshest_attack: RClicks proved interactive-seg conclusions are hostage to click-simulation policy and this effect lives entirely inside that hostage situation — the degradation onset will hold under some placement policies and invert under others; 'too many points confuse SAM' is practitioner folklore.
hidden_assumptions: a policy-robust dose-response exists
negative-click semantics comparable across model families
onset is a property of the image-object pair, not the clicker
killer_experiment: Factorial positive x negative sweep under >=4 policies including RClicks' human-derived clickability model, >=4 model families; claim survives iff degradation-beyond-k holds across the whole policy envelope; onset predictor validated out-of-policy.

one_liner: Relearning-speed (savings) paradigm for VFM forgetting
harshest_attack: The savings paradigm has been ported: Unlearning Isn't Deletion (ICML 2026) uses budget-matched relearning as its primary reversibility probe with a full representational framework, and Reawakening Knowledge (NeurIPS 2024) documents recovery dynamics — the conceptual flag is planted; only the vision/dense quantification remains.
hidden_assumptions: never-trained controls constructible without head-capacity confounds
few-shot relearning measures retained structure not easier optimization geometry
savings comparable across abilities with different sample complexity
killer_experiment: VFM single-task adaptation: savings-vs-dose curves against scratch-head controls AND representational probes (CKA, linear retention); deliverable is the dissociation where retention probes say gone but savings say cheap to restore, localized by layer.
mutated_claim: Savings-vs-dose quantification for dense VFM abilities dissociating storage from retrieval — the vision instantiation of 2505.16831's reversibility framework.

one_liner: Cleaner labels transfer worse (label-quality paradox)
harshest_attack: 'At matched source performance' is unsatisfiable without undertraining the clean-label model — the confound the claim is about; without matching, this is noise-as-regularization folklore (label smoothing era); synthetic iid flips do not model natural annotation variation, per the authors' own risk note.
hidden_assumptions: a non-circular matching protocol exists
synthetic ladders span natural annotation structure
effect is about labels rather than co-varying regularization
killer_experiment: Natural-variation version only: multi-rater segmentation datasets, single-rater precise vs rater-sampled noisy targets at matched budget and matched held-out-rater source Dice; evaluate cross-domain transfer.
mutated_claim: Annotation-convention overfitting: precise single-rater conventions transfer worse than rater-distribution training at matched source quality.

one_liner: Procedural corruptions beat realistic generated ones for robustness training
harshest_attack: WeatherDG and Cityscape-Adverse report diffusion-generated adverse-condition data transfers well to real benchmarks — the bet swims against published current; matched severity across pipelines has no agreed definition; any result is versioned to the current generator and dies with the next release.
hidden_assumptions: severity equatable across pipelines
label integrity is the operative mechanism rather than coverage/diversity
findings survive generator churn
killer_experiment: Same scenes, three arms (procedural / diffusion-edited / diffusion-edited + label-integrity filtering), severity matched by equal reference-model degradation; train identical segmenters, evaluate ACDC + real adverse sets; measure per-arm label-corruption rates — the label-integrity accounting is the contribution regardless of which arm wins.
mutated_claim: Label-integrity accounting of generated vs procedural corruption training (the horse-race slogan dropped).

one_liner: Site-of-origin decodability: natural VFMs vs medical FMs
harshest_attack: The audit exists: arXiv 2501.18055 measures center-of-origin decodability from FM embeddings, finds center predicted better than cancer type, and ranks FMs by a Robustness Index; PANDA-PLUS-Bench extends it — the natural-vs-medical roster change plus one regression is not a paper on its own.
hidden_assumptions: site decodability inversely predicts transfer across model families (unestablished)
site separable from population case-mix via scanner-matched subsets
pathology conclusions don't already answer the radiology question for reviewers
killer_experiment: Cross-family (natural vs >=4 medical FMs) x cross-modality (CXR/CT/pathology) site-decodability + cross-site transfer on scanner-matched subsets; the paper is the decodability-to-transfer correlation and the family contrast, with the Robustness Index as imported baseline.
mutated_claim: Site-invariance as a cross-family pretraining differentiator that predicts cross-site transfer — extending the pathology Robustness Index audit to natural-vs-medical across modalities.

one_liner: Synonym-variance ledger for open-vocabulary segmentation (mutated form)
harshest_attack: The micro-literature completed its life cycle: RENOVATE fixed benchmark names (NeurIPS 2024), open metrics stopped punishing synonyms (2311.03352), and SynCLIP (CVPR 2026) both quantifies synonym-substitution sensitivity across models and trains it away — the ledger's one residual figure lands on a field that already conceded and moved to mitigation.
hidden_assumptions: extension-matched synonym sets constructible at scale
model-generation variance is a stable comparator
practice changes in response to a ledger when fixes already ship
killer_experiment: NONE standalone; fold name-choice as one axis into 0213's protocol-confound audit.

one_liner: Emergent attention segmentation is epiphenomenal (causal intervention)
harshest_attack: Re-imports the attention-is-not-explanation stalemate into vision with the same fatal construct problem: attention maps ARE the mixing weights, so 'intervene while preserving statistics' is near-incoherent and every outcome has a prepared deflation (unchanged = too weak/off-manifold; changed = you broke the network) — the community will split over the method, not the finding.
hidden_assumptions: a meaningful null family of non-segmenting-but-equivalent attention patterns exists
head-level interventions compose linearly for attribution
'uses its attention maps' is distinct from 'computes with attention' as stated
killer_experiment: NONE that silences the construct objection.

one_liner: Pretraining seed variance exceeds published VFM gaps
harshest_attack: The affordable experiment (ViT-S/ImageNet-100 multi-seed) cannot license the flagship-scale indictment: variance does not extrapolate across 3 orders of magnitude, so the paper proves 'seed variance exists at small scale' — generically established by the variance-accounting literature — while the field-reform conclusion remains unfunded.
hidden_assumptions: small-scale variance bounds flagship-scale variance
frozen-probe mIoU variance is the right target
labs change behavior absent flagship-scale evidence
killer_experiment: NONE affordable — the decisive version requires multi-seed flagship-scale pretraining (compute-partner fantasy; per E's own 0293 criterion, converts to kill without the partner).

one_liner: Inverse stability scaling with model size at fixed data
harshest_attack: Instability at fixed LR grids across scales is what muP-style parameterization theory predicts and fixes — the 'law' plausibly measures how wrong standard LR heuristics are, not an intrinsic property; only inverse scaling that survives per-scale LR optimization is a finding, and priors say it won't.
hidden_assumptions: instability comparable across scales at respective optima
3-4 points identify a trend, not a power law
fixed 5k-image tasks are deployment-relevant for ViT-H
killer_experiment: ViT-S/B/L ladder, per-scale variance-minimizing LR at matched final accuracy, 10 seeds, under standard AND muP parameterizations; publish only if instability grows at optimum under both.
mutated_claim: Instability-at-optimum scaling (with the parameterization control), not instability-under-default-heuristics.

one_liner: LoRA memorizes more per-parameter (privacy inversion)
harshest_attack: The 2025-2026 record answers in the wrong direction at scale: 55x lower MIA detection for LoRA vs full FT (2601.12104), up to 10x less verbatim memorization (2502.05087), memorization rising with rank (2507.21009); the per-parameter normalization is metric engineering — privacy risk is a property of the deployed artifact, not a ratio — and no mechanism is offered for a sign flip in few-shot vision.
hidden_assumptions: per-parameter normalization is decision-relevant to anyone
few-shot vision inverts a sign consistent across models/domains/attacks in text
adapter-subspace concentration implies extractability rather than easier defense
killer_experiment: NONE that rescues the inversion headline.

one_liner: Interpolation-frontier kinks as discrete mechanism transitions
harshest_attack: Neyshabur et al. 2020 found essentially flat barrier-free paths between fine-tuned models sharing pretrained init, WiSE-FT curves are famously smooth, thresholded metrics manufacture kinks from smooth score changes, and even reproducible kinks do not license 'discrete mechanism transition' — the prize is unclaimable on a win.
hidden_assumptions: kinks appear in soft losses, not only thresholded metrics
kink locations seed-stable
a mapping from frontier geometry to mechanism exists beyond thresholded-battery correlation
killer_experiment: NONE that secures the mechanistic claim (seed-stable soft-loss kinks would be a curiosity note, not the promised payoff).

one_liner: Synthetic medical data launders privacy (transitive membership leakage)
harshest_attack: Exposed at both ends: Dar et al. show latent diffusion memorizes ~40% of patient data (Nature BME 2025), and Scientific Reports 2024 already mounted the transitive MIA against models trained only on synthetic clinical data — the imaging/dense instantiation is quantification of a demonstrated phenomenon while the field moves to mitigation.
hidden_assumptions: dense-model MIA sensitive enough for second-hand membership signal
effect survives standard dedup/privacy filtering now applied by vendors
generator-membership ground-truth datasets accessible under IRB
killer_experiment: Controlled generator training on known patient splits; segmentation models adapted on synthetic-only data; strong MIAs on generator-set membership; leakage vs generation volume AND vs privacy-filter strength — the filter-defeat/vindication result is the only unclaimed angle.
mutated_claim: Does privacy filtering actually close the transitive membership channel in dense medical adaptation, at what utility cost — a red-team audit of the mitigation stack.

one_liner: Spectral coverage criterion predicts sign of synthetic-data effect
harshest_attack: The iff claim is unfalsifiable armor; the criterion is circular (coverage measured in a freely-chosen encoder geometry, tunable post hoc); it competes against unmentioned cheap baselines (data size, FID, generator recall, class frequency) and the conflicting literature it promises to reconcile conflicts for boring non-geometric reasons.
hidden_assumptions: an encoder-invariant notion of undersampled directions exists
linear eigendirections capture relevant coverage
effect sign stable across training recipes at fixed data
killer_experiment: Pre-registered sign-prediction contest: >=20 (task, generator, ratio) configurations, criterion computed before training in 3 reference encoders, must beat FID/recall/data-size baselines with encoder-robust predictions.
mutated_claim: Drop the iff: pre-registered comparison of coverage-geometry predictors vs cheap baselines for the sign of synthetic-data effects.

one_liner: Whorfian imprint of English spatial categories in visual features
harshest_attack: COMFORT (2410.17385) already demonstrated the English-dominance spatial imprint behaviorally across 109 languages, and language-dependent VLE embedding geometry is documented (2509.23098); the remaining feature-level transmission claim sits behind the data-composition confound, which only caption-translated matched retraining can cut — turning a probe study into a pretraining program.
hidden_assumptions: translation preserves the FoR semantics being tested
public multilingual CLIP variants differ mainly in caption language
linear separability of spatial contrasts is the right transmission measure
killer_experiment: Small-scale matched-pretraining pairs on identical images with EN vs EN+X machine-translated caption mixtures; probe separability of contrasts language X splits and English merges.
mutated_claim: Caption-language composition causally shifts visual spatial-relation geometry at matched images — a small-scale controlled transmission study downstream of COMFORT; HRHR status repriced to mid-cost mechanism study.

one_liner: MIL identifiability predicts which concepts never emerge densely
harshest_attack: Caption supervision IS MIL is an analogy, not a theorem — InfoNCE over continuous embeddings violates the assumptions of the instance-level identifiability toolkit (e.g., NeurIPS 2024 PAC framework); and corpus co-occurrence correlates with visual difficulty, so identifiability scores will predict dense failure through boring covariates unless SSL-difficulty controls are built in.
hidden_assumptions: MIL reduction preserves what matters about contrastive training
open-web corpus statistics approximate the filtered training distribution
identifiability-violating concepts abundant enough to power the test
SSL normalization removes difficulty confounds
killer_experiment: On LAION-trained OpenCLIP: co-occurrence identifiability scores per concept; per-concept dense emergence; regression with SSL-decodability and frequency as covariates — theory survives only if identifiability adds predictive power over frequency + difficulty.
mutated_claim: Empirical program only (covariate-controlled identifiability-emergence regression); theorem-level claims deferred until the MIL reduction is formally defended (theory collaborator still required).
